_doc: Hand-curated equipment data for tools/build_registry.py. 'props': one spec per held weapon/shield/implement (length_m is for a Medium 1.8 m wielder; tris = LOD0 budget). 'monsters': source -> slug -> {wields, hands?, arms?, armed_look?, aka?, note?}. Every slug whose plan gives hands by default, or whose stat block mentions a weapon, must be listed (an empty {} means: reviewed, default hands, holds nothing). See docs/equipment.md.

dagger.desc: a plain steel dagger with a short double-edged blade, small crossguard and leather-wrapped grip

sickle.desc: a curved iron sickle with a crescent blade and a short wooden handle

shortsword.desc: a steel shortsword with a straight double-edged blade, simple crossguard and leather-wrapped grip

scimitar.desc: a steel scimitar with a curved single-edged blade, small crossguard and leather-wrapped grip

rapier.desc: a slender steel rapier with a thin straight blade and a swept basket hilt

longsword.desc: a steel longsword with a straight double-edged blade, cross-shaped guard, leather grip and round pommel

greatsword.desc: a two-handed steel greatsword with a long broad blade, wide crossguard and long leather grip

handaxe.desc: a small iron handaxe with a single bearded blade on a short wooden haft

battleaxe.desc: an iron battleaxe with a broad crescent blade on a wooden haft

greataxe.desc: a two-handed iron greataxe with a huge double-bitted head on a long wooden haft

club.desc: a crude wooden club, thicker at the striking end, with a worn grip

greatclub.desc: a huge two-handed wooden greatclub, a knotted log thick at the head

mace.desc: an iron flanged mace with a ribbed head on a short steel haft

morningstar.desc: an iron morningstar with a spiked ball head on a wooden haft

light-hammer.desc: a small iron throwing hammer with a square head on a short wooden handle

warhammer.desc: an iron warhammer with a heavy square head and a back spike on a wooden haft

quarterstaff.desc: a long gnarled wooden quarterstaff wrapped with leather at the middle

spear.desc: a wooden spear with a leaf-shaped iron spearhead

javelin.desc: a light throwing javelin, a slim wooden shaft with a narrow iron point

pike.desc: a very long wooden pike with a small diamond-shaped iron point

glaive.desc: a glaive: a long wooden pole topped by a heavy single-edged curved blade with saw teeth on the back

fork.desc: an infernal war fork: a long black iron pole ending in two long barbed prongs

harpoon.desc: a barbed iron harpoon on a wooden shaft with a coiled rope tied to its butt

whip.desc: a long braided leather whip with a short stiff handle, laid out straight
whip.rig: spline-IK bone chain (8-12 bones) from the handle

shortbow.desc: a short recurved wooden bow with a taut string

longbow.desc: a tall wooden longbow with a leather-wrapped grip and a taut string
longbow.rig: optional 2-bone limb chain for the draw

hand-crossbow.desc: a small one-handed hand crossbow with a wooden stock and short steel prod

light-crossbow.desc: a light crossbow with a wooden stock, steel prod and taut string

heavy-crossbow.desc: a heavy crossbow with a thick wooden stock, broad steel prod, string and cranking stirrup

pistol.desc: an ornate flintlock pistol with a wooden grip and brass fittings

wand.desc: a slim carved wooden wand with a small crystal at the tip

shield.desc: a round wooden shield with an iron rim and a central iron boss, front face

animated-armor.note: empty gauntlets; art often adds a sword the stat block does not have (Slam only)

barbed-devil.note: Hurl Flame is a spell-like attack, nothing held

chain-devil.note: its chains are wrapped around and grow from its body: baked into the mesh (plus rig chains), not props

cultist-fanatic.note: Pact Blade (1d8 slashing) read as a longsword; Holy Symbol is worn

djinni.note: floating whirlwind lower body but a full humanoid upper body with hands

drider.note: 5.2.1 drider attacks with Foreleg and Poison Burst only; drow-derived art usually adds a sword and bow

dryad.note: Vine Lash and Thorn Burst are magical, nothing held

efreeti.note: Heated Blade (2d6 slashing, Large) read as a scimitar

erinyes.note: 5.2.1 has no bow; the Entangling Rope is worn coiled at the hip

ghost.note: spectral humanoid upper body with hands

glabrezu.note: four arms: two huge pincers (natural weapons, part of the mesh) and two smaller hands; only the hands get sockets

harpy.note: drawn with clawed hands as well as wings; claws are natural weapons

hill-giant.note: Trash Lob throws debris: spawned FX, not a prop

iron-golem.note: Bladed Arm is a blade built into the forearm: part of the mesh

knight.note: 5.2.1 knight: greatsword and heavy crossbow, no shield

lich.note: no weapon or staff in the stat block (Component Pouch is worn); art usually adds a staff

marilith.note: six Pact Blade attacks: one longsword per hand

medusa.note: 5.2.1 medusa has claws, snake hair and Poison Ray; older art gives her a bow

oni.note: 5.2.1 oni attacks with Claw and Nightmare Ray; art usually gives it a glaive

sahuagin-warrior.note: 5.2.1 sahuagin warrior has only claws; art usually gives it a trident

satyr.note: Hooves only in 5.2.1; panpipes are worn on a cord, not held

shambling-mound.note: heap of vines in a humanoid shape; no grip

shield-guardian.note: its shield-like arm is part of the construct, not a prop

minotaur-skeleton.note: Gore and Slam only in 5.2.1; art often adds a greataxe

stone-giant.note: Boulder is a thrown rock: spawned FX, not a carried prop

treant.note: branch arms with twig fingers; slams and hurls bark, never grips a prop

warrior-infantry.note: 5.2.1 gear is Chain Shirt and Spear: no shield

werebear.note: modelled in hybrid form; handaxes usable in humanoid or hybrid form

wereboar.note: hybrid form; javelins usable in humanoid or hybrid form

ogre-zombie.note: Slam only in 5.2.1; older art gives it a morningstar

lemure.note: blob with stubby humanoid arms; mindless, never grips

baboon.note: has real hands but walks on all fours and never wields anything; no sockets needed

xorn.note: three clawed arms used for digging; no grip sockets
